title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Adjudication of Rape Cases

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2000] No. 4
In order to punish rape criminal activities according to law, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the following interpretation is hereby given on the relevant issues concerning the trial of rape cases:
With respect to persons who have reached the age of 14 but not the age of 16, if their sexual relations with a young girl constitute a crime, they shall be convicted and punished for the crime of rape in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 and Article 236, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China; if the sexual relations with a young girl are minor in circumstances and have not yet caused serious consequences, it shall not be deemed a crime.
If an actor commits both the act of raping a woman and the act of having sexual relations with a young girl, he shall be given a severe punishment for the crime of rape in accordance with the provisions of Article 236 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.
